title: The Power of Meta Access in the Software of the Future --- Demonstrated on LLM Chat UIs and Chat AI
abstract: arXiv:2611.08428v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Chat remains the default surface for many large language model (LLM) tasks, even as agentic tools such as OpenCode excel at coding and automation. Yet the model sees the current dialogue but not the workspace around it. We explore meta access---giving the assistant a structured, permissioned view of the interface itself and propose a ladder of levels: feature tutoring; metadata, settings, and preference access; retrieval over summaries and messages, confirmed mutation, and full orchestration. Meta access can turn a chat client from many screens into one entry point for finding, navigating, organising, and operating it, while raising risks around grounding, privacy, prompt injection, and trust. General-purpose agentic harnesses are runtimes; because they can change their own settings, meta access becomes reflexive and needs a separate control-plane boundary. translated_title: 未来软件中“元访问”的力量——以大语言模型聊天界面与Chat AI为例
translated_abstract: 聊天仍然是许多大语言模型（LLM）任务的默认交互界面，即便像OpenCode这样的智能体工具在编程和自动化方面表现出色。然而，模型只能看到当前对话，却看不到其周围的工作区。我们探讨了“元访问”——即让助手获得对界面本身的结构化、经授权的视图，并提出了一系列分级阶梯：功能指导；元数据、设置与偏好访问；对摘要和消息的检索、经确认的变更操作以及完全的编排控制。元访问可以把聊天客户端从多个屏幕转变为一个用于查找、导航、组织和操作的统一入口，同时也会带来关于事实依据、隐私、提示注入和信任方面的风险。通用的智能体框架本质上是运行时环境；由于它们可以更改自身的设置，元访问变得具有自反性，因而需要一个独立的控制平面边界。我们以Chat AI客户端的Meta Chat原型为基础对这一思想进行了验证。该原型构建了有界的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出“元访问”机制——让LLM聊天助手获得对界面自身的结构化、分级授权视图，从而把聊天客户端变成软件的统一操作入口，并通过Meta Chat原型加以验证，同时指出其带来的隐私、提示注入等风险以及对独立控制平面边界的需要。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "meta access"—a ladder of permissioned levels giving LLM chat assistants a structured view of the interface itself—turning a chat client into a single orchestration entry point, demonstrated in the Meta Chat prototype while addressing privacy, prompt injection, and the need for a separate control-plane boundary.
